content.short: Faraway Land is a hyper-social blockchain game with a player-driven economy.
content.description: Faraway Land is a strategy game where players plan and construct factories, houses, and electricity stations to generate resources. The ultimate objective is to create Gear for Mini Royale: Nations through in‑game mechanics. All Gear in the Faraway Land universe exists as on‑chain NFTs that can be minted and freely traded on the marketplace. As you progress, you unlock new territories, buildings, and mechanics. Your mission is straightforward: collect items, use them wisely, and build your first Gear factory.
